mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was most worthwhile: it showed how the diaphragm separates them while routes still connect the regions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the second arm felt predictable after attaching the first, though it completed the model.

surprise.text: The reminder that nerves, blood vessels and the food pipe cross between the chest and abdomen through separate routes made the division less like a solid barrier.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The placements followed named slots and goals, although most were straightforward rather than difficult choices.

continue.text: I might continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems work together; this final assembly was clear, but the individual fittings were mostly predictable.
